name: dimonb-skills
description: Agent skills for driving real work through a repo's pipeline: ship one change end-to-end with self-review, and shipyard a fleet of them in background terminals.

plugins.name: ship
plugins.description: Drive one change end-to-end through a repo's pipeline on GitHub or GitLab — issue, spec, implementation, its own review passes, hand-off or merge. Self-driven: read-only review subagents with adversarial verification, and no stage that waits on an external reviewer.

plugins.name: shipyard
plugins.description: Run ship in background terminals and supervise a fleet of them: one git worktree per change, a status table on a timer, stall and context-ceiling watchdogs, and every escalation carried back to you. Requires the ship plugin.
